body: The tools match a small repair, but the spare was prepared before anyone recorded a fault.
title: A repair set aside
gloss: A prepared pair is left without a clear account of why it was needed.
rival_reading: The tools may have been set out for an everyday repair; nothing identifies what prompted it.

body: A bucket bears a faded field lot mark beneath a newer cleaning label. A hand shovel still has the same fine yellow dust caught in its handle.
title: The spoiled pail
gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
rival_reading: An emergency team could have moved farm supplies during a containment response.
